lines.t: I knew all that You ever said
... I thought ...
I thought that we were chosen,
We set our lamps upon our sills,
Thinking you knew all our names.
Thought to get oil in time to fill.
We said that we would be the first;
Nobody knew the promised day.
When the heavens opened up,
Blessed Hope just blew away.
We dwell where crosses stood as proof,
we learned to bless in gilded halls.
we spoke our creeds like tidy robes -
We wore them when the trumpet called.
We thought, you said -
we were beloved, set apart.
We thought, you said -
the promise held within the heart.
We thought, you said -
we’d stand as bride before the dawn.
we thought - and yet we are left here,
and you are gone.
Proud pastors huff and make excuse,
Was it just blind leading the blind?
We worked wonders in Your Name,
We cast out demons of the night.
The town is ash, the lamps are dry,
Nurseries echo with our steps;
Peace and mercy is our prayer -
Silence answers with its depth.
Where is the scale You would hold,
to measure true what stands or bends?
Where is the voice that called us home,
when in eye's blink, the Bride was cleansed?
We thought, you said -
we were beloved, set apart.
We thought, you said -
the promise held within the heart.
We thought, you said -
we’d stand as Bride before the dawn.
We thought - and yet we are left here,
and you are gone.
I thought my hands were unblemished,
I thought our works would prove my worth.
I tasted Gift and called it grace;
was plunged in water, and called it birth.
Did I mistake the gilding for Your fruit?
And trade Your rains for bottled water sold as Truth?
I feel crushed; an endless ache -
I'm stunned in silence I cannot fake.
You took the Bride; the sky went mute.
I'm left plundered, holding bitter truths.
I thought, you said -
we were beloved, set apart.
I thought, you said -
the promise held within the heart.
I thought, you said -
We’d stand as bride before the dawn.
I thought... - and yet we are left here,
and you are gone.
yet we are left here,
oh, and we were wrong.
I thought that you...
I thought that you were near…
I can never be mistaken?
… I thought.
